contextInspectorConstructorSites.text: test('w3c.context-single-global-host-real-providers','real Library Structured adapter and real Enterprise Spatial/Relation adapters','register both descriptor providers on one host and render each through the same owner','ContextInspectorHost','one Global presentation owner renders genuine family projections while provider/domain ownership stays outside Global',()=>{const bundle={initialDocumentId:'KU-D05-0021',STRUCTURE_TREE,FIXTURES,NOTE_FIXTURES},library=createStructuredConsumerAdapter('library',bundle),enterprise=createEnterpriseAdapter(),spatial=new SpatialModel(enterprise.nodes,enterprise.project()),focus=new TransientFocusOwner(),host=new ContextInspectorHost({transientOwner:focus}),libraryProvider=createLibraryStructuredContextProvider(library),spatialProvider=createSpatialContextProvider({spatialModel:spatial,relationAdapter:enterprise});spatial.select(enterprise.nodes[0].id);host.registerProvider(libraryProvider);host.registerProvider(spatialProvider);host.activate(libraryProvider.id);const libraryHtml=host.renderHTML();host.activate(spatialProvider.id);const spatialHtml=host.renderHTML();assert(host.ownerId===CONTEXT_INSPECTOR_OWNER_ID&&host.contract===CONTEXT_INSPECTOR_CONTRACT&&host.providerIds().join()==='library-structured-context,spatial-context'&&libraryHtml.includes('data-context-inspector-owner="ContextInspectorHost"')&&spatialHtml.includes('data-context-inspector-owner="ContextInspectorHost"')&&libraryHtml.includes('data-context-provider="library-structured-context"')&&spatialHtml.includes('data-context-provider="spatial-context"')&&libraryProvider.owner!=='ContextInspectorHost'&&spatialProvider.owner!=='ContextInspectorHost')});

test('w3c.context-explicit-descriptor-lens-tab-identity','one ContextInspectorHost with real Structured provider','activate provider then switch host-owned tab','ContextInspectorHost','descriptor/provider/lens/tab identities are explicit presentation state and no domain payload is stored there',()=>{const bundle={initialDocumentId:'KU-D05-0021',STRUCTURE_TREE,FIXTURES,NOTE_FIXTURES},library=createStructuredConsumerAdapter('library',bundle),host=new ContextInspectorHost({transientOwner:new TransientFocusOwner()}),provider=createLibraryStructuredContextProvider(library);host.registerProvider(provider);const active=host.activate(provider.id),state1=host.snapshot();host.selectTab('selection');const state2=host.snapshot();assert(active.ok&&active.descriptorId===`library:${library.identity().id}`&&state1.activeLensId==='document'&&state1.activeTabId==='overview'&&state2.activeTabId==='selection'&&host.assertPresentationOnlyState()&&Object.keys(state2).every(key=>!['document','metadata','relations','records','runtime','device','selection','save','blocks','nodes'].includes(key))) });

test('w3c.context-structured-projection-refresh-no-ownership-transfer','real Library Structured document with no selected blocks','select one canonical block externally then re-render active selection tab','StructuredSelectionKernel + LibraryStructuredContextDescriptorProvider + ContextInspectorHost','projection refreshes from canonical selection while host retains only presentation identities',()=>{const bundle={initialDocumentId:'KU-D05-0021',STRUCTURE_TREE,FIXTURES,NOTE_FIXTURES},library=createStructuredConsumerAdapter('library',bundle),host=new ContextInspectorHost({transientOwner:new TransientFocusOwner()}),provider=createLibraryStructuredContextProvider(library);host.registerProvider(provider);host.activate(provider.id);host.selectTab('selection');const before=host.renderHTML(),first=library.snapshot().blocks[0].id;library.selectBlocks([first]);const after=host.renderHTML(),state=host.snapshot();assert(before.includes('data-context-field="selected-count"><dt>Selected blocks</dt><dd dir="ltr">0</dd>')&&after.includes('data-context-field="selected-count"><dt>Selected blocks</dt><dd dir="ltr">1</dd>')&&after.includes(first)&&state.activeProviderId===provider.id&&!('selection'in state))});

test('w3c.context-spatial-stale-selection-deterministic','real Enterprise relation adapter and SpatialModel with one active object','change canonical selection then clear it while the inspector is active','SpatialSelectionNavigationKernel + SpatialContextDescriptorProvider + ContextInspectorHost','descriptor identity refreshes on selection change and stale/inapplicable selection deactivates without cached domain truth',()=>{const enterprise=createEnterpriseAdapter(),spatial=new SpatialModel(enterprise.nodes,enterprise.project()),host=new ContextInspectorHost({transientOwner:new TransientFocusOwner()}),provider=createSpatialContextProvider({spatialModel:spatial,relationAdapter:enterprise}),a=enterprise.nodes[0].id,b=enterprise.nodes[1].id;spatial.select(a);host.registerProvider(provider);host.activate(provider.id);const first=host.renderHTML(),id1=host.snapshot().activeDescriptorId;spatial.select(b,true);const second=host.renderHTML(),id2=host.snapshot().activeDescriptorId;spatial.selectionKernel.clear({source:'w3c-proof'});const stale=host.project();assert(first.includes(a)&&second.includes(a)&&second.includes(b)&&id1!==id2&&!stale.ok&&stale.code==='DESCRIPTOR_INAPPLICABLE'&&host.snapshot().activeProviderId===null)});

test('w3c.context-readonly-no-domain-mutation','real Library adapter, Enterprise relation/spatial state and Runs runtime truth after canonical selection','render both providers and navigate inspector lens/tab only','ContextInspectorHost','document, relation, runtime/device, geometry and selection canonical bytes remain unchanged by inspector presentation',()=>{const bundle={initialDocumentId:'KU-D05-0021',STRUCTURE_TREE,FIXTURES,NOTE_FIXTURES},library=createStructuredConsumerAdapter('library',bundle),enterprise=createEnterpriseAdapter(),runs=new W03V34RunsAdapter(),spatial=new SpatialModel(enterprise.nodes,enterprise.project()),host=new ContextInspectorHost({transientOwner:new TransientFocusOwner()}),lp=createLibraryStructuredContextProvider(library),sp=createSpatialContextProvider({spatialModel:spatial,relationAdapter:enterprise});spatial.select(enterprise.nodes[0].id);host.registerProvider(lp);host.registerProvider(sp);const runtime=()=>({devices:runs.devices,sessions:runs.sessions,events:runs.events,recorded:runs.recorded()});const before={document:JSON.stringify(library.snapshot()),transaction:JSON.stringify(library.transactionDescriptor()),relations:JSON.stringify(enterprise.records),relationVersion:enterprise.version,spatial:JSON.stringify(spatial.snapshot()),selection:JSON.stringify(spatial.selectionKernel.descriptorReceipt()),runtime:JSON.stringify(runtime())};host.activate(lp.id);host.renderHTML();host.selectTab('selection');host.renderHTML();host.activate(sp.id);host.renderHTML();host.selectLens('relations');host.renderHTML();const after={document:JSON.stringify(library.snapshot()),transaction:JSON.stringify(library.transactionDescriptor()),relations:JSON.stringify(enterprise.records),relationVersion:enterprise.version,spatial:JSON.stringify(spatial.snapshot()),selection:JSON.stringify(spatial.selectionKernel.descriptorReceipt()),runtime:JSON.stringify(runtime())};assert(JSON.stringify(after)===JSON.stringify(before))});

test('w3c.context-invalid-inapplicable-safe-rejection','one valid active Library descriptor plus malformed and empty-selection providers','attempt activation of invalid descriptor and inapplicable Spatial descriptor','ContextInspectorHost + ContextDescriptorContract','rejections are explicit and leave the valid active presentation state byte-identical',()=>{const bundle={initialDocumentId:'KU-D05-0021',STRUCTURE_TREE,FIXTURES,NOTE_FIXTURES},library=createStructuredConsumerAdapter('library',bundle),enterprise=createEnterpriseAdapter(),spatial=new SpatialModel(enterprise.nodes,enterprise.project()),host=new ContextInspectorHost({transientOwner:new TransientFocusOwner()}),valid=createLibraryStructuredContextProvider(library),bad=defineContextDescriptorProvider({id:'bad-context',family:'structured',owner:'BadProofProvider',describe:()=>({id:'bad',providerId:'bad-context',family:'structured',subject:'Bad',lenses:[]})}),emptySpatial=createSpatialContextProvider({spatialModel:spatial,relationAdapter:enterprise});host.registerProvider(valid);host.registerProvider(bad);host.registerProvider(emptySpatial);host.activate(valid.id);const before=JSON.stringify(host.snapshot()),badResult=host.activate(bad.id),badState=JSON.stringify(host.snapshot()),emptyResult=host.activate(emptySpatial.id),emptyState=JSON.stringify(host.snapshot());assert(!badResult.ok&&badResult.code==='INVALID_DESCRIPTOR'&&!emptyResult.ok&&emptyResult.code==='DESCRIPTOR_INAPPLICABLE'&&before===badState&&before===emptyState&&CONTEXT_DESCRIPTOR_CONTRACT.owner==='ContextInspectorHost')});

test('w3c.context-transient-focus-return','accepted TransientFocusOwner and real Library provider with focusable invoker','open inspector then close through host-level action with Escape reason','ContextInspectorHost + TransientFocusOwner','focus lifecycle is delegated to accepted transient owner and returns to invoker exactly once',()=>{let focused=0;const invoker={isConnected:true,disabled:false,getAttribute:()=>null,focus:()=>{focused++}},transient=new TransientFocusOwner(),bundle={initialDocumentId:'KU-D05-0021',STRUCTURE_TREE,FIXTURES,NOTE_FIXTURES},library=createStructuredConsumerAdapter('library',bundle),provider=createLibraryStructuredContextProvider(library),host=new ContextInspectorHost({transientOwner:transient});host.registerProvider(provider);const opened=host.open(provider.id,{}, {invoker});assert(opened.ok&&transient.top()?.id==='context-inspector-host'&&host.snapshot().open);host.hostAction('inspector.close',{reason:'escape'});assert(!host.snapshot().open&&transient.top()===null&&focused===1&&transient.snapshot().lastDismissal?.owner===TRANSIENT_FOCUS_OWNER&&transient.snapshot().lastDismissal?.reason==='escape')});

test('w3c.context-central-policy-change-exact-revert','same host and genuine Library/Spatial providers under comfortable policy','change host density centrally, render both, then restore exact prior policy','ContextInspectorHost','one presentation policy change reaches both providers and exact revert reproduces both prior renderings',()=>{const bundle={initialDocumentId:'KU-D05-0021',STRUCTURE_TREE,FIXTURES,NOTE_FIXTURES},library=createStructuredConsumerAdapter('library',bundle),enterprise=createEnterpriseAdapter(),spatial=new SpatialModel(enterprise.nodes,enterprise.project()),host=new ContextInspectorHost({transientOwner:new TransientFocusOwner()}),lp=createLibraryStructuredContextProvider(library),sp=createSpatialContextProvider({spatialModel:spatial,relationAdapter:enterprise});spatial.select(enterprise.nodes[0].id);host.registerProvider(lp);host.registerProvider(sp);const original=host.snapshotPolicy();host.activate(lp.id);const beforeLibrary=host.renderHTML();host.activate(sp.id);const beforeSpatial=host.renderHTML();host.setPolicy({density:'compact'});host.activate(lp.id);const changedLibrary=host.renderHTML();host.activate(sp.id);const changedSpatial=host.renderHTML();host.setPolicy(original);host.activate(lp.id);const afterLibrary=host.renderHTML();host.activate(sp.id);const afterSpatial=host.renderHTML();assert(changedLibrary.includes('data-density="compact"')&&changedSpatial.includes('data-density="compact"')&&beforeLibrary!==changedLibrary&&beforeSpatial!==changedSpatial&&beforeLibrary===afterLibrary&&beforeSpatial===afterSpatial)});

test('w3c.context-active-inapplicable-closes-ghost-transient','open real Spatial provider with one selected object and focusable invoker','clear canonical Spatial selection then project active inspector','ContextInspectorHost + TransientFocusOwner','active descriptor invalidation closes host, removes transient, clears identities, restores focus and returns truthful reconciliation receipt',()=>{const enterprise=createEnterpriseAdapter(),spatial=new SpatialModel(enterprise.nodes,enterprise.project()),transient=new TransientFocusOwner();let focused=0;const invoker={isConnected:true,disabled:false,getAttribute:()=>null,focus:()=>{focused++}},provider=createSpatialContextProvider({spatialModel:spatial,relationAdapter:enterprise}),host=new ContextInspectorHost({transientOwner:transient});spatial.select(enterprise.nodes[0].id);host.registerProvider(provider);const opened=host.open(provider.id,{}, {invoker});spatial.selectionKernel.clear({source:'w3c-active-invalidation'});const receipt=host.project(),state=host.snapshot(),focus=transient.snapshot();assert(opened.ok&&!receipt.ok&&receipt.code==='DESCRIPTOR_INAPPLICABLE'&&receipt.reconciled===true&&receipt.reconciliation==='CLOSED_NO_REPLACEMENT'&&receipt.reason==='descriptor-inapplicable'&&!state.open&&state.activeProviderId===null&&state.activeDescriptorId===null&&state.activeLensId===null&&state.activeTabId===null&&transient.record('context-inspector-host')===null&&focus.active.length===0&&focus.top===null&&focus.lastDismissal?.reason==='context-reconcile:descriptor-inapplicable'&&focus.lastDismissal?.focusTargetKind==='invoker'&&focused===1&&receipt.transientActive===false&&receipt.hostState.open===false)});

test('w3c.context-provider-removal-while-open-closes-cleanly','open real Library/Structured provider with focusable invoker','unregister the currently active provider','ContextInspectorHost + TransientFocusOwner','provider removal closes inspector and clears transient/focus lifecycle without domain ownership transfer',()=>{const bundle={initialDocumentId:'KU-D05-0021',STRUCTURE_TREE,FIXTURES,NOTE_FIXTURES},library=createStructuredConsumerAdapter('library',bundle),provider=createLibraryStructuredContextProvider(library),transient=new TransientFocusOwner();let focused=0;const invoker={isConnected:true,disabled:false,getAttribute:()=>null,focus:()=>{focused++}},host=new ContextInspectorHost({transientOwner:transient});host.registerProvider(provider);host.open(provider.id,{}, {invoker});const removed=host.unregisterProvider(provider.id),state=host.snapshot(),focus=transient.snapshot();assert(removed===true&&!host.providerIds().includes(provider.id)&&!state.open&&state.activeProviderId===null&&state.activeDescriptorId===null&&state.lastTransition==='reconcile:unregister:provider-unregistered:closed'&&transient.record('context-inspector-host')===null&&focus.lastDismissal?.reason==='context-reconcile:provider-unregistered'&&focus.lastDismissal?.focusTargetKind==='invoker'&&focused===1)});

test('w3c.context-invalid-descriptor-while-open-closes-cleanly','open provider whose descriptor starts valid and can become malformed','invalidate active descriptor lenses then project again','ContextInspectorHost + ContextDescriptorContract + TransientFocusOwner','active INVALID_DESCRIPTOR closes host and returns explicit reconciliation receipt with no ghost transient',()=>{let invalid=false,focused=0;const transient=new TransientFocusOwner(),invoker={isConnected:true,disabled:false,getAttribute:()=>null,focus:()=>{focused++}},provider=defineContextDescriptorProvider({id:'w3c-toggle-invalid',family:'structured',owner:'ToggleInvalidProofProvider',describe:()=>({id:'toggle-invalid',providerId:'w3c-toggle-invalid',family:'structured',subject:'Toggle invalid',domainOwner:'ProofDomain',lenses:invalid?[]:[{id:'context',label:'Context',tabs:[{id:'overview',label:'Overview',fields:[{id:'value',label:'Value',value:'valid'}]}]}]})}),host=new ContextInspectorHost({transientOwner:transient});host.registerProvider(provider);assert(host.open(provider.id,{}, {invoker}).ok);invalid=true;const receipt=host.project(),state=host.snapshot();assert(!receipt.ok&&receipt.code==='INVALID_DESCRIPTOR'&&receipt.reconciled&&receipt.reconciliation==='CLOSED_NO_REPLACEMENT'&&receipt.reason==='invalid-descriptor'&&!state.open&&state.activeProviderId===null&&transient.record('context-inspector-host')===null&&transient.snapshot().lastDismissal?.reason==='context-reconcile:invalid-descriptor'&&focused===1)});

test('w3c.context-switch-valid-provider-and-reopen-after-invalidation','real Library and Spatial providers with accepted TransientFocusOwner','open Library, switch to valid Spatial, invalidate Spatial, then reopen Library','ContextInspectorHost','valid provider switching preserves one transient; invalidation closes it; reopening creates one fresh consistent lifecycle',()=>{const bundle={initialDocumentId:'KU-D05-0021',STRUCTURE_TREE,FIXTURES,NOTE_FIXTURES},library=createStructuredConsumerAdapter('library',bundle),enterprise=createEnterpriseAdapter(),spatial=new SpatialModel(enterprise.nodes,enterprise.project()),lp=createLibraryStructuredContextProvider(library),sp=createSpatialContextProvider({spatialModel:spatial,relationAdapter:enterprise}),transient=new TransientFocusOwner();let focused=0;const invoker={isConnected:true,disabled:false,getAttribute:()=>null,focus:()=>{focused++}},host=new ContextInspectorHost({transientOwner:transient});spatial.select(enterprise.nodes[0].id);host.registerProvider(lp);host.registerProvider(sp);assert(host.open(lp.id,{}, {invoker}).ok&&transient.active().join()==='context-inspector-host');const switched=host.activate(sp.id),switchState=host.snapshot();assert(switched.ok&&switchState.open&&switchState.activeProviderId===sp.id&&transient.active().join()==='context-inspector-host');spatial.selectionKernel.clear({source:'w3c-reopen-invalidation'});const invalidated=host.project();assert(!invalidated.ok&&!host.snapshot().open&&transient.active().length===0&&focused===1);const reopened=host.open(lp.id,{}, {invoker}),reopenedState=host.snapshot();assert(reopened.ok&&reopenedState.open&&reopenedState.activeProviderId===lp.id&&transient.active().join()==='context-inspector-host'&&transient.active().length===1);host.close('w3c-reopen-cleanup');assert(!host.snapshot().open&&transient.active().length===0&&focused===2)});

test('w3c.context-invalidation-presentation-only-domain-truth-unchanged','real Library document, Spatial/Relation state and Runs runtime truth','open Library, switch Spatial, invalidate through canonical selection owner, reconcile host, then reopen Library','ContextInspectorHost','inspector reconciliation mutates only presentation/focus state; document/relation/runtime/save truth stays byte-identical and selection changes only through canonical Spatial owner',()=>{const bundle={initialDocumentId:'KU-D05-0021',STRUCTURE_TREE,FIXTURES,NOTE_FIXTURES},library=createStructuredConsumerAdapter('library',bundle),enterprise=createEnterpriseAdapter(),runs=new W03V34RunsAdapter(),spatial=new SpatialModel(enterprise.nodes,enterprise.project()),lp=createLibraryStructuredContextProvider(library),sp=createSpatialContextProvider({spatialModel:spatial,relationAdapter:enterprise}),host=new ContextInspectorHost({transientOwner:new TransientFocusOwner()});spatial.select(enterprise.nodes[0].id);host.registerProvider(lp);host.registerProvider(sp);const stableTruth=()=>JSON.stringify({document:library.snapshot(),transaction:library.transactionDescriptor(),relations:enterprise.records,relationVersion:enterprise.version,runtime:{devices:runs.devices,sessions:runs.sessions,events:runs.events,recorded:runs.recorded()}}),before=stableTruth();host.open(lp.id);host.activate(sp.id);host.renderHTML();const beforeClearSelection=JSON.stringify(spatial.selectionKernel.descriptorReceipt());spatial.selectionKernel.clear({source:'w3c-canonical-owner-only'});const afterClearSelection=JSON.stringify(spatial.selectionKernel.descriptorReceipt());const receipt=host.project();host.open(lp.id);host.renderHTML();const after=stableTruth();assert(before===after&&beforeClearSelection!==afterClearSelection&&!receipt.ok&&receipt.reconciled&&host.assertPresentationOnlyState()===true&&host.snapshot().activeProviderId===lp.id)});
